After focused searches of issuer disclosures, investor materials, and secondary coverage, Apple’s largest-customer description was found in 2026 secondary reporting, but reliable current evidence naming Google or Microsoft was not found. Stopped with those atoms unresolved rather than infer identities from anonymized customer references.
The issuer materials reviewed discuss customers and customer programs without naming Google or Microsoft; anonymized customer references cannot be mapped to a brand.
The Apple ranking comes from secondary reporting, not an issuer customer-concentration table; the report gives no revenue share, amount, or ranking methodology.
The named Microsoft evidence from securities research concerns a historical period. The 2024 Google/Microsoft customer list is user-published and unsourced.
